experiment: experimental-script-transform: isolated complete compiler integration and original-source provenance

result.processExitEvidence: Strict command actually returned exit code 1 through the execution tool; the separate read-only audit independently inferred that code from the saved result.

identity.sourceHashSerialization: SHA256 of JSON.stringify of the full sourceHashes object preserved in the private audit, in persisted key order; full identities also remain in summary.json.

audit.meaning: Saved evidence and calculations reproduced; not compiler compatibility acceptance.
checks: Recomputed declared 340-source and 45-build-input closures against current files and before/after records
Verified 360 complete JS control outputs, 90 actual complete compiler outputs and 72 integrated stage records
Checked each iteration owns the same indexes as the independent captured control; loader upstream/instrumented identities agree
Validated raw native payloads and direct stage delivery; both representative pages retain native code in the final script
Verified all 36 fallback calls execute JS once and return exact baseline stage and complete output
Replayed all compiler and stage oracles without rerunning compiler/native
audit.supplementaryAuditScope: Asserts both representative scenarios have exactly two actual native records and that all four stage scripts are delivered into final compiler output; rechecks source, build and raw evidence identity.

v5SameInputComparison.precondition: Source, serialized request and tagged baseline stage result are equal; native code is byte-identical before/after the source-map change.
v5SameInputComparison.interpretation: Removed findings include restored source import candidates and two missing rename-name anchors per page. Introduced findings mix genuine import origins absent in Babel with adjacent synthetic helper/module tokens inheriting GLB origins; the count is not a quality or regression metric.

verification.meaning: 210 tool tests passed before gate hardening; the final affected 11-test suite passed, including the two added regression cases. No unrelated broad retest was needed.

limitations: No compiler or native invocation was run during this audit; saved records were validated and both frozen oracles replayed.
Validator/oracle replay is not an independent compiler or runtime implementation. Real mini-program runtime, performance, RSS and other platforms remain untested here.

Full compiler comparison conservatively rejects every both-unmapped anchor without a generated-region ownership proof. Baseline map defects remain differences; counts are not a quality or speed metric.
The 32 complete comparisons that pass may include JS fallback or no-stage cases; they are not 32 native successes.
Source closures do not include all installed dependency/toolchain bytes; successful release build and binary hash are not a hermetic/reproducible build claim.
Same AST and source locations do not independently establish runtime semantics. v5/current-integrated comparisons are restricted to exactly equal source, serialized request and baseline stage result.
The native-success corpus has no nonempty warning list. Nonempty warning delivery, callback failure and malformed/failed native outcomes are covered by synthetic tests only.

The original JS fast path remains unchanged in production. The isolated native wrapper selects native before the original JS stage; this corpus does not establish fastSetup hit behavior or a speedup for that path.
Generated regions still lack explicit unmapped fences. Clearing spans does not prevent same-line GLB inheritance, including injected import helpers and minified registration/export.
Expression-source root spans do not reconstruct token provenance lost during earlier template rewrite/stringify. No synthetic source coordinate was invented to satisfy Babel.
No installed dependency closure, reproducible build, public production integration, real Stable WeChat DevTools runtime, build/HMR latency or RSS acceptance is established here.
The comparison keeps unsupported inputs as actual JS fallback and preserves every original map. completed=true is diagnostic completion only; comparisonPassed=false remains the compatibility result.
